note: Towns County has no queryable zoning district layer found after searching ArcGIS Hub/Online, county and city sites. City of Young Harris publishes its official zoning map only as a static map file (media/726, built from county tax parcel data, adopted 2014) with no service or download. Hiawassee publishes its zoning ordinance on Municode and no GIS zoning layer was found. The county's own GIS (qPublic/Schneider) is a parcel viewer with no public zoning district service found. Towns County's unincorporated zoning appears only in third-party sites (zoneomics), with no official source.
